audit: Codex source audit before the full AI experiment; not independently human-validated. Pack 09 was already visible in the earlier integration/correction demonstration. All ten are development-visible; no training or held-out test.
normalization: Numeric Decimal equality, commas removed. Text case/whitespace normalized. Single durations imply equal bounds even if endpoints omitted. Conditions compare declared equivalent sets only; unknown qualifiers fail. Raw clause boundaries and price-note wording are not scored.
